title: Refuse offline commands that lack a durable sample target
test_file_status: planned new file in existing tests/voice lane

evidence.observed: Run the listener with SYNTH-A current and SENAITE offline; it queues only ('record_result',('7','pH')). Set the session to SYNTH-B, then invoke its captured replay callback: the write targets SYNTH-B.

user_impact: A queued result for sample A can be written to sample B after the current sample changes.
implementation_scope: Within this single-file job, refuse to enqueue implicit-current-sample commands while offline and give actionable spoken feedback. Fail closed when the replay callback receives legacy targetless record_result, start_test or mark_complete rows. Do not add a cross-file context envelope or restore global session state temporarily.
acceptance: Offline record_result, start_test and mark_complete are not queued and explain that the operator must reconnect/reselect the sample.
Legacy targetless queued commands cannot mutate whichever sample happens to be current.
Explicit-target and read-only offline commands keep their supported behavior; online command behavior is preserved.
constraints: Change only the named source file and test file for implementation.
All verification uses synthetic fixtures and mocks; no live SENAITE writes or email.
Do not run jobs sharing a source file as concurrent writers.
duplicate_check: No selected source appears in any of 17 open PR file lists or 32 merged-since-2026-10-09 PR file lists in the saved GitHub snapshot.
